name: The Lessons of Ta'zo
summary: A librarian asks you to bring magical works such as The Lessons of Ta'zo to the library. Each addition helps expand its collection and knowledge.

sections.title: A Library's Collection
sections.body: A librarian asks whether you have brought something for the library's collection. Magical works that might benefit the library are welcome, and your efforts help expand its knowledge.

faq.q: Who is asking for magical works?
faq.answer: A librarian asks you to bring magical works that might benefit the library. The Lessons of Ta'zo is one such work.

faq.q: What does the librarian want brought to the library?
faq.answer: The librarian asks for magical works that might benefit the library's collection.
Librarians gather such works in Stormwind and in the Undercity.

faq.q: Why does the librarian ask for magical works?
faq.answer: The librarian says the library's knowledge expands through your efforts.
